name: Rabé de las Calzadas (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a blue wavy diagonal at the upper hoist and a red wavy diagonal at the lower fly, both from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rabé de las Calzadas (a castle, an eagle and a chequy field).
history: Municipal flag of Rabé de las Calzadas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy diagonal stripe from the lower hoist to the upper fly, nearer the upper hoist
wavy diagonal stripe nearer the lower fly
Rabé de las Calzadas arms — castle, eagle and chequy
